ko.title: 콜럼버스의 날 또는 원주민의 날: 은행과 채권 시장은 쉬는데 주식 시장은 계속 거래되는 이유

segments.src: On the second Monday of October, the United States does not act as one.
segments.tr: 10월의 두 번째 월요일, 미국은 하나처럼 움직이지 않습니다.

segments.src: Federal offices are closed, bond desks are dark, and the mail does not run.
segments.tr: 연방 정부 기관은 문을 닫고, 채권 데스크는 운영되지 않으며, 우편물도 배달되지 않습니다.

segments.src: Yet the New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq open at 9:30 a.m.
segments.tr: 하지만 뉴욕증권거래소(NYSE)와 나스닥(Nasdaq)은 오전 9시 30분에

segments.src: as usual.
segments.tr: 평소처럼 개장합니다.

segments.src: In many cities and states, the day carries a different name altogether.
segments.tr: 많은 도시와 주에서는 이 날을 완전히 다른 이름으로 부릅니다.

segments.src: Here is a plain look at what closes, what stays open, and how the holiday's meaning has changed.
segments.tr: 무엇이 문을 닫고 무엇이 운영되는지, 그리고 이 휴일의 의미가 어떻게 변화했는지에 대해 알기 쉽게 살펴보겠습니다.

segments.src: ## What closes
segments.tr: ## 문을 닫는 곳

segments.src: Because the day is a federal holiday, the following generally observe it:
segments.tr: 이 날은 연방 공휴일이기 때문에 일반적으로 다음 기관들은 휴무를 준수합니다:

segments.src: - **Federal government offices.** Most non-essential federal agencies are closed, and federal employees get a paid day off.
segments.tr: - **연방 정부 기관.** 대부분의 비필수 연방 기관은 문을 닫으며, 연방 공무원들은 유급 휴일을 갖습니다.

segments.src: - **The Federal Reserve.** Federal Reserve Banks are closed, and the Fedwire funds-transfer service and the Federal Reserve's ACH operations do not run for the day.
segments.tr: - **연방준비제도(Fed).** 연방준비은행은 문을 닫으며, Fedwire 자금 이체 서비스와 연방준비제도의 ACH 운영도 이날은 가동되지 않습니다.

segments.src: - **The U.S. Postal Service.** Regular mail delivery is suspended, and post offices are closed.
segments.tr: - **미국 우정청(USPS).** 일반 우편 배달은 중단되며 우체국도 문을 닫습니다.

segments.src: - **Federal courts.** Courthouses are closed, apart from emergency matters.
segments.tr: - **연방 법원.** 긴급한 사안을 제외하고 법원은 문을 닫습니다.

segments.src: - **The bond market.** The Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) recommends a full close for U.S. fixed-income trading, so Treasury and most corporate bond desks stay shut.
segments.tr: - **채권 시장.** 증권산업금융시장협회(SIFMA)는 미국 채권 거래의 전면 휴장을 권고하므로, 국채 및 대부분의 회사채 데스크는 운영되지 않습니다.

segments.src: Many banks close their branches as well, since they follow the Federal Reserve calendar.
segments.tr: 많은 은행도 연방준비제도 달력을 따르기 때문에 지점 문을 닫습니다.

segments.src: This is a custom rather than a legal requirement for private institutions, so some banks, credit unions and online lenders keep limited hours.
segments.tr: 이는 민간 기관에 대한 법적 요구 사항이라기보다는 관습이므로, 일부 은행, 신용협동조합 및 온라인 대출 기관은 제한된 시간 동안 운영하기도 합니다.

segments.src: Transactions started on the holiday, such as deposits and transfers, are usually processed the next business day.
segments.tr: 휴일에 시작된 입금이나 이체와 같은 거래는 일반적으로 다음 영업일에 처리됩니다.

segments.src: ## What stays open
segments.tr: ## 운영되는 곳

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: 미국

segments.src: stock exchanges, including the NYSE and Nasdaq, keep their regular schedule on this holiday.
segments.tr: 주식 시장은 NYSE와 나스닥을 포함하여 이 휴일에도 평소 일정대로 운영됩니다.

segments.src: Options markets generally trade as well.
segments.tr: 옵션 시장도 일반적으로 거래가 이루어집니다.

segments.src: Their holiday calendars are set by the exchanges themselves and include only a few closures, such as New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr.
segments.tr: 이들의 휴일 달력은 거래소 자체적으로 설정하며, 새해 첫날, 마틴 루터 킹 주니어

segments.src: Day, Presidents' Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas.
segments.tr: 탄생일, 대통령의 날, 성금요일, 메모리얼 데이, 준틴스(Juneteenth), 독립기념일, 노동절, 추수감사절, 크리스마스와 같이 몇몇 휴일에만 문을 닫습니다.

segments.src: Columbus Day and Veterans Day are not on that list.
segments.tr: 콜럼버스의 날과 재향군인의 날은 그 목록에 포함되어 있지 않습니다.

segments.src: The result is a lopsided trading day.
segments.tr: 그 결과 거래일이 불균형하게 운영됩니다.

segments.src: Stocks trade, but the settlement system that moves cash and securities depends on the banking infrastructure that is closed.
segments.tr: 주식은 거래되지만, 현금과 증권을 이동시키는 결제 시스템은 문을 닫은 은행 인프라에 의존하기 때문입니다.

segments.src: As a result, stock trades made on the holiday settle on a slightly delayed schedule.
segments.tr: 결과적으로 휴일에 이루어진 주식 거래는 약간 지연된 일정으로 결제됩니다.

segments.src: Volume is often lighter than usual, because bond-market participants and many institutional traders are away.
segments.tr: 채권 시장 참여자와 많은 기관 투자자들이 자리를 비우기 때문에 거래량은 평소보다 적은 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: Some large firms also operate with reduced staff.
segments.tr: 일부 대형 기업들도 인력을 줄여 운영합니다.

segments.src: With Treasury markets closed, there is no regular benchmark for yields during the day.
segments.tr: 채권 시장이 문을 닫으면 당일 수익률에 대한 정기적인 벤치마크가 없습니다.

segments.src: Investors who watch interest rates often wait until Tuesday for a fresh reading, and any news released over the holiday may only be reflected in bond prices when trading resumes.
segments.tr: 금리를 주시하는 투자자들은 종종 화요일까지 새로운 수치를 기다리며, 휴일 동안 발표된 뉴스는 거래가 재개될 때 채권 가격에만 반영될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the calendars differ
segments.tr: ## 달력이 다른 이유

segments.src: The split comes from history and custom, not from any single rule.
segments.tr: 이러한 차이는 단일 규칙이 아닌 역사와 관습에서 비롯됩니다.

segments.src: The federal calendar is set by law and by the Federal Reserve's observance of it.
segments.tr: 연방 달력은 법률과 연방준비제도의 준수 사항에 의해 설정됩니다.

segments.src: Exchange calendars are set by private operators and approved by regulators, and they have never tracked the federal list exactly.
segments.tr: 거래소 달력은 민간 운영자가 설정하고 규제 당국의 승인을 받으며, 연방 정부의 목록을 정확히 따르지 않았습니다.

segments.src: Other days, such as Good Friday, run the other way: it is not a federal holiday, but stock exchanges close for it.
segments.tr: 성금요일과 같은 다른 날은 반대로, 연방 공휴일은 아니지만 주식 시장은 이날 문을 닫습니다.

segments.src: ## A holiday with a changing meaning
segments.tr: ## 의미가 변화하는 휴일

segments.src: Columbus Day was first marked in the United States in the 18th and 19th centuries, with early celebrations in cities such as New York.
segments.tr: 콜럼버스의 날은 18세기와 19세기에 미국에서 처음 기념되었으며, 뉴욕과 같은 도시에서 초기 기념 행사가 열렸습니다.

segments.src: The day gained national momentum in the late 19th century, particularly among Italian American communities that saw it as a celebration of heritage and belonging at a time of widespread discrimination.
segments.tr: 이 날은 19세기 후반에 전국적인 추진력을 얻었으며, 특히 만연한 차별 속에서 이 날을 유산과 소속감의 축제로 여겼던 이탈리아계 미국인 사회에서 두드러졌습니다.

segments.src: President Franklin D.
segments.tr: 프랭클린 D.

segments.src: Roosevelt proclaimed it a national observance in 1937, and it became a federal holiday observed on the second Monday of October through the Uniform Monday Holiday Act, which took effect in 1971.
segments.tr: 루즈벨트 대통령은 1937년에 이를 국가 기념일로 선포했고, 1971년부터 시행된 '통일 월요일 휴일법(Uniform Monday Holiday Act)'을 통해 10월의 두 번째 월요일에 기념하는 연방 공휴일이 되었습니다.

segments.src: In recent decades, many communities have questioned whether the day should honor Christopher Columbus, citing the harm that European colonization caused Indigenous peoples.
segments.tr: 최근 수십 년 동안 많은 지역 사회에서는 유럽의 식민 지배가 원주민에게 끼친 해악을 언급하며, 이 날이 크리스토퍼 콜럼버스를 기려야 하는지에 대해 의문을 제기해 왔습니다.

segments.src: South Dakota began observing Native American Day in place of Columbus Day in 1990.
segments.tr: 사우스다코타주는 1990년부터 콜럼버스의 날 대신 '아메리카 원주민의 날'을 기념하기 시작했습니다.

segments.src: Berkeley, California, adopted Indigenous Peoples' Day in 1992, and a growing number of states, cities, school districts and universities have since followed with Indigenous Peoples' Day or similar names.
segments.tr: 캘리포니아주 버클리는 1992년에 '원주민의 날'을 채택했으며, 그 이후로 점점 더 많은 주, 도시, 교육구 및 대학들이 '원주민의 날' 또는 유사한 명칭을 따르고 있습니다.

segments.src: In 2021, President Biden issued the first presidential proclamation recognizing Indigenous Peoples' Day, and he issued a Columbus Day proclamation at the same time.
segments.tr: 2021년 바이든 대통령은 원주민의 날을 인정하는 첫 대통령 포고문을 발표했으며, 동시에 콜럼버스의 날 포고문도 함께 발표했습니다.

segments.src: The federal statute still calls the holiday Columbus Day.
segments.tr: 연방 법령은 여전히 이 휴일을 콜럼버스의 날이라고 부릅니다.

segments.src: That is why federal calendars, the Federal Reserve schedule and bond-market calendars still use the name, even while local governments and institutions use another.
segments.tr: 그렇기 때문에 지방 정부와 기관들이 다른 이름을 사용하더라도 연방 달력, 연방준비제도 일정, 채권 시장 달력은 여전히 이 이름을 사용합니다.

segments.src: Some places mark both.
segments.tr: 일부 지역에서는 두 가지 모두를 기념하기도 합니다.

segments.src: Italian American organizations continue to hold parades and cultural events, and many Native American communities hold their own gatherings, educational programs and commemorations on the same day.
segments.tr: 이탈리아계 미국인 단체들은 계속해서 퍼레이드와 문화 행사를 개최하며, 많은 아메리카 원주민 사회도 같은 날에 자체적인 모임, 교육 프로그램 및 기념 행사를 엽니다.

segments.src: ## What to expect
segments.tr: ## 예상해야 할 점

segments.src: - **Plan around the Fed calendar.** If you need to move money, expect transfers to post on Tuesday.
segments.tr: - **연준 달력에 맞춰 계획하세요.** 돈을 이체해야 한다면 화요일에 처리될 것으로 예상하십시오.

segments.src: - **Check local hours.** State and city offices, libraries, schools and public transit vary widely, depending on whether a jurisdiction observes the day and under what name.
segments.tr: - **지역 운영 시간을 확인하세요.** 주 및 시청, 도서관, 학교, 대중교통은 해당 관할 구역이 이 날을 기념하는지, 어떤 이름으로 기념하는지에 따라 운영 여부가 크게 다릅니다.

segments.src: - **Check before you go.** Banks, credit unions and businesses may set their own holiday hours, so confirm before making a trip.
segments.tr: - **방문 전 확인하세요.** 은행, 신용협동조합 및 기업들은 자체적인 휴일 운영 시간을 정할 수 있으므로 방문하기 전에 확인하십시오.

segments.src: One date on the calendar, then, carries several meanings at once: a pause in the financial plumbing, a day when equities keep moving, and an occasion that communities across the country continue to define in different ways.
segments.tr: 결국 달력의 한 날짜는 금융 시스템의 일시 정지, 주식 시장은 계속 움직이는 날, 그리고 전국 각지의 지역 사회가 계속해서 다른 방식으로 정의해 나가는 기념일이라는 여러 가지 의미를 동시에 담고 있습니다.

zh.title: 哥伦布日还是原住民日：为什么银行和债券市场关闭而股票市场继续交易

segments.src: On the second Monday of October, the United States does not act as one.
segments.tr: 在十月的第二个星期一，美国并非步调一致。

segments.src: Federal offices are closed, bond desks are dark, and the mail does not run.
segments.tr: 联邦办公室关闭，债券交易台熄灯，邮件暂停投递。

segments.src: Yet the New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq open at 9:30 a.m.
segments.tr: 然而，纽约证券交易所和纳斯达克交易所于上午9点30分照常开盘。

segments.src: as usual.
segments.tr: 照常营业。

segments.src: In many cities and states, the day carries a different name altogether.
segments.tr: 在许多城市和州，这一天有着完全不同的名称。

segments.src: Here is a plain look at what closes, what stays open, and how the holiday's meaning has changed.
segments.tr: 以下是关于什么关闭、什么保持开放以及该节日意义如何改变的简要概述。

segments.src: ## What closes
segments.tr: ## 闭市情况

segments.src: Because the day is a federal holiday, the following generally observe it:
segments.tr: 由于这一天是联邦假日，以下机构通常会放假：

segments.src: - **Federal government offices.** Most non-essential federal agencies are closed, and federal employees get a paid day off.
segments.tr: - **联邦政府办公室。** 大多数非必要的联邦机构关闭，联邦雇员享有带薪假期。

segments.src: - **The Federal Reserve.** Federal Reserve Banks are closed, and the Fedwire funds-transfer service and the Federal Reserve's ACH operations do not run for the day.
segments.tr: - **联邦储备委员会。** 联邦储备银行关闭，Fedwire资金转账服务和美联储的ACH业务当天暂停运行。

segments.src: - **The U.S. Postal Service.** Regular mail delivery is suspended, and post offices are closed.
segments.tr: - **美国邮政署。** 常规邮件投递暂停，邮局关闭。

segments.src: - **Federal courts.** Courthouses are closed, apart from emergency matters.
segments.tr: - **联邦法院。** 除紧急事务外，法院关闭。

segments.src: - **The bond market.** The Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) recommends a full close for U.S. fixed-income trading, so Treasury and most corporate bond desks stay shut.
segments.tr: - **债券市场。** 证券业和金融市场协会（SIFMA）建议美国固定收益交易全天休市，因此美国国债和大多数公司债交易台关闭。

segments.src: Many banks close their branches as well, since they follow the Federal Reserve calendar.
segments.tr: 许多银行也关闭其营业网点，因为它们遵循美联储的日历。

segments.src: This is a custom rather than a legal requirement for private institutions, so some banks, credit unions and online lenders keep limited hours.
segments.tr: 对于私营机构而言，这是一种习惯而非法律要求，因此一些银行、信用合作社和在线借贷机构保持有限的营业时间。

segments.src: Transactions started on the holiday, such as deposits and transfers, are usually processed the next business day.
segments.tr: 在节日期间发起的交易，例如存款和转账，通常会在下一个工作日处理。

segments.src: ## What stays open
segments.tr: ## 开放情况

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: 美国

segments.src: stock exchanges, including the NYSE and Nasdaq, keep their regular schedule on this holiday.
segments.tr: 股票交易所，包括纽交所和纳斯达克，在此节日保持正常交易时间。

segments.src: Options markets generally trade as well.
segments.tr: 期权市场通常也正常交易。

segments.src: Their holiday calendars are set by the exchanges themselves and include only a few closures, such as New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr.
segments.tr: 它们的节假日历由交易所自行制定，仅包含少数休市日，例如元旦、马丁·路德·金纪念日、总统日、耶稣受难日、阵亡将士纪念日、六月节、独立日、劳动节、感恩节和圣诞节。

segments.src: Day, Presidents' Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas.
segments.tr: 哥伦布日和退伍军人节不在该名单之列。

segments.src: Columbus Day and Veterans Day are not on that list.
segments.tr: 结果导致这是一个失衡的交易日。

segments.src: The result is a lopsided trading day.
segments.tr: 股票交易照常进行，但负责转移现金和证券的清算系统依赖于当天关闭的银行基础设施。

segments.src: Stocks trade, but the settlement system that moves cash and securities depends on the banking infrastructure that is closed.
segments.tr: 因此，在节日期间进行的股票交易会在稍有延迟的日程下完成交割。

segments.src: As a result, stock trades made on the holiday settle on a slightly delayed schedule.
segments.tr: 由于债券市场参与者和许多机构交易员不在岗，交易量通常比平时清淡。

segments.src: Volume is often lighter than usual, because bond-market participants and many institutional traders are away.
segments.tr: 一些大型公司也以精简的人员配置运营。

segments.src: Some large firms also operate with reduced staff.

es.title: Día de la Raza o Día de los Pueblos Indígenas: Por qué los bancos y los mercados de bonos cierran mientras las acciones siguen operando

segments.src: On the second Monday of October, the United States does not act as one.
segments.tr: El segundo lunes de octubre, Estados Unidos no actúa como un todo.

segments.src: Federal offices are closed, bond desks are dark, and the mail does not run.
segments.tr: Las oficinas federales están cerradas, las mesas de bonos están inactivas y el correo no funciona.

segments.src: Yet the New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq open at 9:30 a.m.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, la Bolsa de Nueva York y el Nasdaq abren a las 9:30 a.m.

segments.src: as usual.
segments.tr: como de costumbre.

segments.src: In many cities and states, the day carries a different name altogether.
segments.tr: En muchas ciudades y estados, el día tiene un nombre completamente diferente.

segments.src: Here is a plain look at what closes, what stays open, and how the holiday's meaning has changed.
segments.tr: Aquí presentamos un vistazo sencillo a lo que cierra, lo que permanece abierto y cómo ha cambiado el significado de la festividad.

segments.src: ## What closes
segments.tr: ## Lo que cierra

segments.src: Because the day is a federal holiday, the following generally observe it:
segments.tr: Debido a que el día es un feriado federal, generalmente lo observan los siguientes:

segments.src: - **Federal government offices.** Most non-essential federal agencies are closed, and federal employees get a paid day off.
segments.tr: - **Oficinas del gobierno federal.** La mayoría de las agencias federales no esenciales están cerradas y los empleados federales tienen un día libre remunerado.

segments.src: - **The Federal Reserve.** Federal Reserve Banks are closed, and the Fedwire funds-transfer service and the Federal Reserve's ACH operations do not run for the day.
segments.tr: - **La Reserva Federal.** Los bancos de la Reserva Federal están cerrados, y el servicio de transferencia de fondos Fedwire y las operaciones ACH de la Reserva Federal no funcionan durante el día.

segments.src: - **The U.S. Postal Service.** Regular mail delivery is suspended, and post offices are closed.
segments.tr: - **El Servicio Postal de EE. UU.** La entrega regular de correo está suspendida y las oficinas de correos están cerradas.

segments.src: - **Federal courts.** Courthouses are closed, apart from emergency matters.
segments.tr: - **Tribunales federales.** Los tribunales están cerrados, salvo para asuntos de emergencia.

segments.src: - **The bond market.** The Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) recommends a full close for U.S. fixed-income trading, so Treasury and most corporate bond desks stay shut.
segments.tr: - **El mercado de bonos.** La Asociación de la Industria de Valores y Mercados Financieros (SIFMA) recomienda un cierre total para la negociación de renta fija en EE. UU., por lo que las mesas de bonos del Tesoro y la mayoría de los bonos corporativos permanecen cerradas.

segments.src: Many banks close their branches as well, since they follow the Federal Reserve calendar.
segments.tr: Muchos bancos también cierran sus sucursales, ya que siguen el calendario de la Reserva Federal.

segments.src: This is a custom rather than a legal requirement for private institutions, so some banks, credit unions and online lenders keep limited hours.
segments.tr: Esta es una costumbre más que un requisito legal para las instituciones privadas, por lo que algunos bancos, cooperativas de crédito y prestamistas en línea mantienen horarios limitados.

segments.src: Transactions started on the holiday, such as deposits and transfers, are usually processed the next business day.
segments.tr: Las transacciones iniciadas en el feriado, como depósitos y transferencias, generalmente se procesan el siguiente día hábil.

segments.src: ## What stays open
segments.tr: ## Lo que permanece abierto

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: Las bolsas de valores de EE. UU.,

segments.src: stock exchanges, including the NYSE and Nasdaq, keep their regular schedule on this holiday.
segments.tr: incluidas la NYSE y el Nasdaq, mantienen su horario habitual en este feriado.

segments.src: Options markets generally trade as well.
segments.tr: Los mercados de opciones generalmente también operan.

segments.src: Their holiday calendars are set by the exchanges themselves and include only a few closures, such as New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr.
segments.tr: Sus calendarios de feriados son establecidos por las propias bolsas e incluyen solo unos pocos cierres, como el Día de Año Nuevo, el Día de Martin Luther King Jr.

segments.src: Day, Presidents' Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas.
segments.tr: Day, el Día de los Presidentes, el Viernes Santo, el Día de los Caídos, Juneteenth, el Día de la Independencia, el Día del Trabajo, Acción de Gracias y Navidad.

segments.src: Columbus Day and Veterans Day are not on that list.
segments.tr: El Día de la Raza (Columbus Day) y el Día de los Veteranos no están en esa lista.

segments.src: The result is a lopsided trading day.
segments.tr: El resultado es un día de negociación desigual.

segments.src: Stocks trade, but the settlement system that moves cash and securities depends on the banking infrastructure that is closed.
segments.tr: Las acciones se negocian, pero el sistema de liquidación que mueve efectivo y valores depende de la infraestructura bancaria que está cerrada.

segments.src: As a result, stock trades made on the holiday settle on a slightly delayed schedule.
segments.tr: Como resultado, las operaciones bursátiles realizadas en el feriado se liquidan con un calendario ligeramente retrasado.

segments.src: Volume is often lighter than usual, because bond-market participants and many institutional traders are away.
segments.tr: El volumen suele ser menor de lo habitual, porque los participantes del mercado de bonos y muchos operadores institucionales están ausentes.

segments.src: Some large firms also operate with reduced staff.
segments.tr: Algunas grandes empresas también operan con personal reducido.

segments.src: With Treasury markets closed, there is no regular benchmark for yields during the day.
segments.tr: Con los mercados del Tesoro cerrados, no hay un punto de referencia regular para los rendimientos durante el día.

segments.src: Investors who watch interest rates often wait until Tuesday for a fresh reading, and any news released over the holiday may only be reflected in bond prices when trading resumes.
segments.tr: Los inversores que observan las tasas de interés a menudo esperan hasta el martes para obtener una lectura actualizada, y cualquier noticia publicada durante el feriado puede reflejarse en los precios de los bonos solo cuando se reanude la negociación.

segments.src: ## Why the calendars differ
segments.tr: ## Por qué difieren los calendarios

segments.src: The split comes from history and custom, not from any single rule.
segments.tr: La división proviene de la historia y la costumbre, no de una regla única.

segments.src: The federal calendar is set by law and by the Federal Reserve's observance of it.
segments.tr: El calendario federal está establecido por ley y por la observancia del mismo por parte de la Reserva Federal.

segments.src: Exchange calendars are set by private operators and approved by regulators, and they have never tracked the federal list exactly.
segments.tr: Los calendarios de las bolsas son establecidos por operadores privados y aprobados por los reguladores, y nunca han seguido exactamente la lista federal.

segments.src: Other days, such as Good Friday, run the other way: it is not a federal holiday, but stock exchanges close for it.
segments.tr: Otros días, como el Viernes Santo, funcionan al revés: no es un feriado federal, pero las bolsas de valores cierran por él.

segments.src: ## A holiday with a changing meaning
segments.tr: ## Un feriado con un significado cambiante

segments.src: Columbus Day was first marked in the United States in the 18th and 19th centuries, with early celebrations in cities such as New York.
segments.tr: El Día de la Raza se celebró por primera vez en Estados Unidos en los siglos XVIII y XIX, con celebraciones tempranas en ciudades como Nueva York.

segments.src: The day gained national momentum in the late 19th century, particularly among Italian American communities that saw it as a celebration of heritage and belonging at a time of widespread discrimination.
segments.tr: El día cobró impulso nacional a finales del siglo XIX, particularmente entre las comunidades italoamericanas que lo vieron como una celebración de su herencia y pertenencia en una época de discriminación generalizada.

segments.src: President Franklin D.
segments.tr: El presidente Franklin D.

segments.src: Roosevelt proclaimed it a national observance in 1937, and it became a federal holiday observed on the second Monday of October through the Uniform Monday Holiday Act, which took effect in 1971.
segments.tr: Roosevelt lo proclamó una observancia nacional en 1937, y se convirtió en un feriado federal observado el segundo lunes de octubre a través de la Ley Uniforme de Feriados de Lunes, que entró en vigor en 1971.

segments.src: In recent decades, many communities have questioned whether the day should honor Christopher Columbus, citing the harm that European colonization caused Indigenous peoples.
segments.tr: En las últimas décadas, muchas comunidades han cuestionado si el día debería honrar a Cristóbal Colón, citando el daño que la colonización europea causó a los pueblos indígenas.

segments.src: South Dakota began observing Native American Day in place of Columbus Day in 1990.
segments.tr: Dakota del Sur comenzó a observar el Día de los Nativos Americanos en lugar del Día de la Raza en 1990.

segments.src: Berkeley, California, adopted Indigenous Peoples' Day in 1992, and a growing number of states, cities, school districts and universities have since followed with Indigenous Peoples' Day or similar names.
segments.tr: Berkeley, California, adoptó el Día de los Pueblos Indígenas en 1992, y un número creciente de estados, ciudades, distritos escolares y universidades han seguido desde entonces con el Día de los Pueblos Indígenas o nombres similares.

segments.src: In 2021, President Biden issued the first presidential proclamation recognizing Indigenous Peoples' Day, and he issued a Columbus Day proclamation at the same time.
segments.tr: En 2021, el presidente Biden emitió la primera proclamación presidencial reconociendo el Día de los Pueblos Indígenas, y emitió una proclamación del Día de la Raza al mismo tiempo.

segments.src: The federal statute still calls the holiday Columbus Day.
segments.tr: El estatuto federal todavía llama al feriado Día de la Raza (Columbus Day).

segments.src: That is why federal calendars, the Federal Reserve schedule and bond-market calendars still use the name, even while local governments and institutions use another.
segments.tr: Es por eso que los calendarios federales, el cronograma de la Reserva Federal y los calendarios del mercado de bonos todavía usan el nombre, incluso mientras los gobiernos locales y las instituciones usan otro.

segments.tr: Algunos lugares marcan ambos.

segments.src: Italian American organizations continue to hold parades and cultural events, and many Native American communities hold their own gatherings, educational programs and commemorations on the same day.
segments.tr: Las organizaciones italoamericanas continúan realizando desfiles y eventos culturales, y muchas comunidades nativas americanas realizan sus propias reuniones, programas educativos y conmemoraciones el mismo día.

segments.src: ## What to expect
segments.tr: ## Qué esperar

segments.src: - **Plan around the Fed calendar.** If you need to move money, expect transfers to post on Tuesday.
segments.tr: - **Planifique en torno al calendario de la Fed.** Si necesita mover dinero, espere que las transferencias se contabilicen el martes.

segments.src: - **Check local hours.** State and city offices, libraries, schools and public transit vary widely, depending on whether a jurisdiction observes the day and under what name.
segments.tr: - **Verifique los horarios locales.** Las oficinas estatales y municipales, bibliotecas, escuelas y el transporte público varían ampliamente, dependiendo de si una jurisdicción observa el día y bajo qué nombre.

segments.src: - **Check before you go.** Banks, credit unions and businesses may set their own holiday hours, so confirm before making a trip.
segments.tr: - **Verifique antes de ir.** Los bancos, cooperativas de crédito y empresas pueden establecer sus propios horarios de feriados, así que confirme antes de hacer un viaje.

segments.src: One date on the calendar, then, carries several meanings at once: a pause in the financial plumbing, a day when equities keep moving, and an occasion that communities across the country continue to define in different ways.
segments.tr: Una fecha en el calendario, entonces, conlleva varios significados a la vez: una pausa en la infraestructura financiera, un día en que las acciones siguen moviéndose y una ocasión que las comunidades de todo el país continúan definiendo de diferentes maneras.

fr.title: Columbus Day ou Indigenous Peoples' Day : pourquoi les banques et les marchés obligataires ferment alors que les actions continuent de s'échanger

segments.src: On the second Monday of October, the United States does not act as one.
segments.tr: Le deuxième lundi d'octobre, les États-Unis ne fonctionnent pas comme un seul homme.

segments.src: Federal offices are closed, bond desks are dark, and the mail does not run.
segments.tr: Les bureaux fédéraux sont fermés, les bureaux de change obligataire sont inactifs et le courrier n'est pas distribué.

segments.src: Yet the New York Stock Exchange and Nasdaq open at 9:30 a.m.
segments.tr: Pourtant, le New York Stock Exchange et le Nasdaq ouvrent à 9h30

segments.src: as usual.
segments.tr: comme d'habitude.

segments.src: In many cities and states, the day carries a different name altogether.
segments.tr: Dans de nombreuses villes et États, ce jour porte un nom tout à fait différent.

segments.src: Here is a plain look at what closes, what stays open, and how the holiday's meaning has changed.
segments.tr: Voici un aperçu simple de ce qui ferme, de ce qui reste ouvert et de la façon dont la signification de ce jour férié a évolué.

segments.src: ## What closes
segments.tr: ## Ce qui ferme

segments.src: Because the day is a federal holiday, the following generally observe it:
segments.tr: Comme il s'agit d'un jour férié fédéral, les entités suivantes l'observent généralement :

segments.src: - **Federal government offices.** Most non-essential federal agencies are closed, and federal employees get a paid day off.
segments.tr: - **Bureaux du gouvernement fédéral.** La plupart des agences fédérales non essentielles sont fermées et les employés fédéraux bénéficient d'un jour de congé payé.

segments.src: - **The Federal Reserve.** Federal Reserve Banks are closed, and the Fedwire funds-transfer service and the Federal Reserve's ACH operations do not run for the day.
segments.tr: - **La Réserve fédérale.** Les banques de la Réserve fédérale sont fermées, et le service de transfert de fonds Fedwire ainsi que les opérations ACH de la Réserve fédérale ne fonctionnent pas ce jour-là.

segments.src: - **The U.S. Postal Service.** Regular mail delivery is suspended, and post offices are closed.
segments.tr: - **Le service postal américain (U.S. Postal Service).** La distribution régulière du courrier est suspendue et les bureaux de poste sont fermés.

segments.src: - **Federal courts.** Courthouses are closed, apart from emergency matters.
segments.tr: - **Les tribunaux fédéraux.** Les palais de justice sont fermés, sauf pour les affaires urgentes.

segments.src: - **The bond market.** The Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) recommends a full close for U.S. fixed-income trading, so Treasury and most corporate bond desks stay shut.
segments.tr: - **Le marché obligataire.** La Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) recommande une fermeture complète pour les transactions sur titres à revenu fixe aux États-Unis ; les bureaux de change du Trésor et de la plupart des obligations d'entreprises restent donc fermés.

segments.src: Many banks close their branches as well, since they follow the Federal Reserve calendar.
segments.tr: De nombreuses banques ferment également leurs agences, car elles suivent le calendrier de la Réserve fédérale.

segments.src: This is a custom rather than a legal requirement for private institutions, so some banks, credit unions and online lenders keep limited hours.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'une coutume plutôt que d'une obligation légale pour les institutions privées, de sorte que certaines banques, coopératives de crédit et prêteurs en ligne maintiennent des horaires limités.

segments.src: Transactions started on the holiday, such as deposits and transfers, are usually processed the next business day.
segments.tr: Les transactions initiées pendant ce jour férié, telles que les dépôts et les virements, sont généralement traitées le jour ouvrable suivant.

segments.src: ## What stays open
segments.tr: ## Ce qui reste ouvert

segments.src: U.S.
segments.tr: Les

segments.src: stock exchanges, including the NYSE and Nasdaq, keep their regular schedule on this holiday.
segments.tr: bourses américaines, y compris le NYSE et le Nasdaq, conservent leurs horaires habituels lors de ce jour férié.

segments.src: Options markets generally trade as well.
segments.tr: Les marchés d'options sont généralement ouverts également.

segments.src: Their holiday calendars are set by the exchanges themselves and include only a few closures, such as New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr.
segments.tr: Leurs calendriers de jours fériés sont fixés par les bourses elles-mêmes et ne comprennent que quelques fermetures, comme le jour de l'An, le jour de Martin Luther King Jr.

segments.src: Day, Presidents' Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas.
segments.tr: Day, le Presidents' Day, le Vendredi saint, le Memorial Day, le Juneteenth, le jour de l'Indépendance, la fête du Travail, Thanksgiving et Noël.

segments.src: Columbus Day and Veterans Day are not on that list.
segments.tr: Le Columbus Day et le Veterans Day ne figurent pas sur cette liste.

segments.src: The result is a lopsided trading day.
segments.tr: Le résultat est une journée de négociation déséquilibrée.

segments.src: Stocks trade, but the settlement system that moves cash and securities depends on the banking infrastructure that is closed.
segments.tr: Les actions s'échangent, mais le système de règlement qui déplace les liquidités et les titres dépend de l'infrastructure bancaire qui est fermée.

segments.src: As a result, stock trades made on the holiday settle on a slightly delayed schedule.
segments.tr: Par conséquent, les transactions boursières effectuées ce jour férié sont réglées selon un calendrier légèrement retardé.

segments.src: Volume is often lighter than usual, because bond-market participants and many institutional traders are away.
segments.tr: Le volume est souvent plus faible que d'habitude, car les acteurs du marché obligataire et de nombreux traders institutionnels sont absents.

segments.src: Some large firms also operate with reduced staff.
segments.tr: Certaines grandes entreprises fonctionnent également avec un personnel réduit.

segments.src: With Treasury markets closed, there is no regular benchmark for yields during the day.
segments.tr: Avec la fermeture des marchés du Trésor, il n'y a pas de référence habituelle pour les rendements au cours de la journée.

segments.src: Investors who watch interest rates often wait until Tuesday for a fresh reading, and any news released over the holiday may only be reflected in bond prices when trading resumes.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs qui surveillent les taux d'intérêt attendent souvent mardi pour obtenir une nouvelle lecture, et toute nouvelle publiée pendant le jour férié ne sera peut-être reflétée dans les prix des obligations qu'à la reprise des transactions.

segments.src: ## Why the calendars differ
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les calendriers diffèrent

segments.src: The split comes from history and custom, not from any single rule.
segments.tr: Cette divergence provient de l'histoire et de la coutume, et non d'une règle unique.

segments.src: The federal calendar is set by law and by the Federal Reserve's observance of it.
segments.tr: Le calendrier fédéral est fixé par la loi et par l'observance qu'en fait la Réserve fédérale.

segments.src: Exchange calendars are set by private operators and approved by regulators, and they have never tracked the federal list exactly.
segments.tr: Les calendriers des bourses sont fixés par des opérateurs privés et approuvés par les régulateurs, et ils n'ont jamais suivi exactement la liste fédérale.

segments.src: Other days, such as Good Friday, run the other way: it is not a federal holiday, but stock exchanges close for it.
segments.tr: D'autres jours, comme le Vendredi saint, fonctionnent à l'inverse : ce n'est pas un jour férié fédéral, mais les bourses ferment pour l'occasion.

segments.src: ## A holiday with a changing meaning
segments.tr: ## Un jour férié dont la signification change

segments.src: As a result, stock trades made on the holiday settle on a slightly delayed schedule.

segments.src: Volume is often lighter than usual, because bond-market participants and many institutional traders are away.

segments.src: ## Why the calendars differ
segments.tr: ## Por que os calendários diferem

segments.src: The split comes from history and custom, not from any single rule.

segments.src: Other days, such as Good Friday, run the other way: it is not a federal holiday, but stock exchanges close for it.
segments.tr: Outros dias, como a Sexta-feira Santa, funcionam ao contrário: não é um feriado federal, mas as bolsas de valores fecham para ele.

segments.src: ## A holiday with a changing meaning
segments.tr: ## Um feriado com significado em mudança

segments.src: Columbus Day was first marked in the United States in the 18th and 19th centuries, with early celebrations in cities such as New York.
segments.tr: O Dia de Colombo foi marcado pela primeira vez nos Estados Unidos nos séculos XVIII e XIX, com celebrações iniciais em cidades como Nova York.

segments.src: The day gained national momentum in the late 19th century, particularly among Italian American communities that saw it as a celebration of heritage and belonging at a time of widespread discrimination.
segments.tr: O dia ganhou impulso nacional no final do século XIX, particularmente entre as comunidades ítalo-americanas que o viam como uma celebração da herança e do pertencimento em um momento de discriminação generalizada.

segments.src: President Franklin D.
segments.tr: O presidente Franklin D.

segments.src: Roosevelt proclaimed it a national observance in 1937, and it became a federal holiday observed on the second Monday of October through the Uniform Monday Holiday Act, which took effect in 1971.
segments.tr: Roosevelt o proclamou uma comemoração nacional em 1937, e tornou-se um feriado federal observado na segunda segunda-feira de outubro por meio da Lei Uniforme de Feriados de Segunda-feira, que entrou em vigor em 1971.

segments.src: In recent decades, many communities have questioned whether the day should honor Christopher Columbus, citing the harm that European colonization caused Indigenous peoples.
segments.tr: Nas últimas décadas, muitas comunidades questionaram se o dia deveria homenagear Cristóvão Colombo, citando os danos que a colonização europeia causou aos povos indígenas.

segments.src: South Dakota began observing Native American Day in place of Columbus Day in 1990.
segments.tr: A Dakota do Sul começou a observar o Dia dos Nativos Americanos em vez do Dia de Colombo em 1990.

segments.src: Berkeley, California, adopted Indigenous Peoples' Day in 1992, and a growing number of states, cities, school districts and universities have since followed with Indigenous Peoples' Day or similar names.

segments.src: In 2021, President Biden issued the first presidential proclamation recognizing Indigenous Peoples' Day, and he issued a Columbus Day proclamation at the same time.
segments.tr: Em 2021, o presidente Biden emitiu a primeira proclamação presidencial reconhecendo o Dia dos Povos Indígenas, e ele emitiu uma proclamação do Dia de Colombo ao mesmo tempo.

segments.src: The federal statute still calls the holiday Columbus Day.
segments.tr: O estatuto federal ainda chama o feriado de Dia de Colombo.

segments.src: That is why federal calendars, the Federal Reserve schedule and bond-market calendars still use the name, even while local governments and institutions use another.
segments.tr: É por isso que os calendários federais, o cronograma do Federal Reserve e os calendários do mercado de títulos ainda usam o nome, mesmo enquanto os governos locais e as instituições usam outro.

segments.src: Some places mark both.
segments.tr: Alguns lugares marcam ambos.

segments.src: Italian American organizations continue to hold parades and cultural events, and many Native American communities hold their own gatherings, educational programs and commemorations on the same day.
segments.tr: As organizações ítalo-americanas continuam a realizar desfiles e eventos culturais, e muitas comunidades nativas americanas realizam seus próprios encontros, programas educacionais e comemorações no mesmo dia.

segments.src: ## What to expect
segments.tr: ## O que esperar

segments.src: - **Plan around the Fed calendar.** If you need to move money, expect transfers to post on Tuesday.
segments.tr: - **Planeje-se em torno do calendário do Fed.** Se você precisar movimentar dinheiro, espere que as transferências sejam lançadas na terça-feira.

segments.src: - **Check local hours.** State and city offices, libraries, schools and public transit vary widely, depending on whether a jurisdiction observes the day and under what name.
segments.tr: - **Verifique os horários locais.** Os escritórios estaduais e municipais, bibliotecas, escolas e transporte público variam amplamente, dependendo de se uma jurisdição observa o dia e sob qual nome.

segments.src: - **Check before you go.** Banks, credit unions and businesses may set their own holiday hours, so confirm before making a trip.
segments.tr: - **Verifique antes de ir.** Bancos, cooperativas de crédito e empresas podem definir seus próprios horários de feriado, portanto, confirme antes de fazer uma viagem.

segments.src: One date on the calendar, then, carries several meanings at once: a pause in the financial plumbing, a day when equities keep moving, and an occasion that communities across the country continue to define in different ways.
segments.tr: Uma data no calendário, então, carrega vários significados ao mesmo tempo: uma pausa no encanamento financeiro, um dia em que as ações continuam se movendo e uma ocasião que comunidades em todo o país continuam a definir de maneiras diferentes.

segments.tr: 債券市場の参加者や多くの機関投資家が不在であるため、取引量は通常よりも少ないことが多い。

segments.src: Some large firms also operate with reduced staff.
segments.tr: 一部の大手企業も人員を削減して業務を行っている。

segments.src: With Treasury markets closed, there is no regular benchmark for yields during the day.
segments.tr: 国債市場が閉鎖されているため、日中の利回りに関する通常のベンチマークが存在しない。

segments.src: Investors who watch interest rates often wait until Tuesday for a fresh reading, and any news released over the holiday may only be reflected in bond prices when trading resumes.
segments.tr: 金利を注視する投資家は新しい数値が出るまで火曜日まで待つことが多く、祝日中に発表されたニュースは取引が再開されたときにのみ債券価格に反映される可能性がある。

segments.src: ## Why the calendars differ
segments.tr: ## カレンダーが異なる理由

segments.src: The split comes from history and custom, not from any single rule.
segments.tr: この分裂は、単一のルールからではなく、歴史と慣習に由来する。

segments.src: The federal calendar is set by law and by the Federal Reserve's observance of it.
segments.tr: 連邦政府のカレンダーは法律およびそれに従う連邦準備制度によって定められている。

segments.src: Exchange calendars are set by private operators and approved by regulators, and they have never tracked the federal list exactly.
segments.tr: 取引所のカレンダーは民間事業者によって設定され規制当局によって承認されるものであり、連邦政府のリストと完全に一致したことは一度もない。

segments.src: Other days, such as Good Friday, run the other way: it is not a federal holiday, but stock exchanges close for it.
segments.tr: グッドフライデーなどの他の日は逆の動きをする。連邦祝日ではないが、株式取引所は休場となる。

segments.src: ## A holiday with a changing meaning
segments.tr: ## 意味合いが変化してきた祝日

segments.src: Columbus Day was first marked in the United States in the 18th and 19th centuries, with early celebrations in cities such as New York.
segments.tr: コロンブス・デイが米国で最初に祝われたのは18世紀および19世紀であり、ニューヨークなどの都市で初期の祝賀が行われた。

segments.src: The day gained national momentum in the late 19th century, particularly among Italian American communities that saw it as a celebration of heritage and belonging at a time of widespread discrimination.
segments.tr: この日は19世紀後半に全国的な勢力を獲得し、特にイタリア系アメリカ人のコミュニティの間で、広く差別が蔓延していた時代に自分たちの遺産と帰属意識を祝うものとして見なされた。

segments.src: President Franklin D.
segments.tr: フランクリン・D・

segments.src: Roosevelt proclaimed it a national observance in 1937, and it became a federal holiday observed on the second Monday of October through the Uniform Monday Holiday Act, which took effect in 1971.
segments.tr: ルーズベルト大統領は1937年にこれを国の記念日として宣言し、1971年に発効した「統一月曜日休日法（Uniform Monday Holiday Act）」を通じて10月の第2月曜日に祝われる連邦祝日となった。

segments.src: In recent decades, many communities have questioned whether the day should honor Christopher Columbus, citing the harm that European colonization caused Indigenous peoples.
segments.tr: 近年の数十年間、多くのコミュニティは、ヨーロッパの植民地化が先住民族にもたらした害を引き合いに出し、この日がクリストファー・コロンブスを称えるべきかどうか疑問視している。

segments.src: South Dakota began observing Native American Day in place of Columbus Day in 1990.
segments.tr: サウスダコタ州は1990年にコロンブス・デイに代えてネイティブ・アメリカン・デイの祝賀を開始した。

segments.src: Berkeley, California, adopted Indigenous Peoples' Day in 1992, and a growing number of states, cities, school districts and universities have since followed with Indigenous Peoples' Day or similar names.
segments.tr: カリフォルニア州バークレーは1992年に「先住民族の日（Indigenous Peoples' Day）」を採用し、それ以降、増加傾向にある州、都市、学区、大学が「先住民族の日」またはそれに類する名前でそれに追随している。

segments.src: In 2021, President Biden issued the first presidential proclamation recognizing Indigenous Peoples' Day, and he issued a Columbus Day proclamation at the same time.
segments.tr: 2021年、バイデン大統領は先住民族の日を認める初めての大統領布告を発令し、同時にコロンブス・デイの布告も発令した。

segments.src: The federal statute still calls the holiday Columbus Day.
segments.tr: 連邦法規では依然としてこの祝日をコロンブス・デイと呼んでいる。

segments.src: That is why federal calendars, the Federal Reserve schedule and bond-market calendars still use the name, even while local governments and institutions use another.
segments.tr: 地方自治体や機関が別の名称を使用している現在でも、連邦政府のカレンダー、連邦準備制度のスケジュール、債券市場のカレンダーが依然としてその名称を使用しているのはそのためである。

segments.src: Some places mark both.
segments.tr: 両方を祝う場所もある。

segments.src: Italian American organizations continue to hold parades and cultural events, and many Native American communities hold their own gatherings, educational programs and commemorations on the same day.
segments.tr: イタリア系アメリカ人の組織はパレードや文化的イベントを引き続き開催しており、多くの先住民族のコミュニティも同日に独自の集会、教育プログラム、記念行事を行っている。

segments.src: ## What to expect
segments.tr: ## 予想されること

segments.tr: - **FRBのカレンダーを中心に計画を立てる。** 資金移動が必要な場合は、送金が火曜日に反映されることを想定しておく。

segments.src: - **Check local hours.** State and city offices, libraries, schools and public transit vary widely, depending on whether a jurisdiction observes the day and under what name.
segments.tr: - **地元の営業時間を確認する。** 州や市のオフィス、図書館、学校、公共交通機関は、管轄区域がこの日を祝うかどうか、またどのような名称で祝うかによって大きく異なる。

segments.src: - **Check before you go.** Banks, credit unions and businesses may set their own holiday hours, so confirm before making a trip.
segments.tr: - **出かける前に確認する。** 銀行、信用組合、企業は独自の休日を設定している場合があるため、外出する前に確認すること。

segments.src: One date on the calendar, then, carries several meanings at once: a pause in the financial plumbing, a day when equities keep moving, and an occasion that communities across the country continue to define in different ways.
segments.tr: したがって、カレンダー上の1つの日付には、金融システムの小休止、株式が動き続ける日、そして全国のコミュニティがさまざまな方法で定義し続けている行事という、いくつかの意味が同時に込められている。

segments.src: On the second Monday of October, the United States does not act as one.
segments.tr: Am zweiten Montag im Oktober agieren die Vereinigten Staaten nicht als Einheit.

segments.src: Federal offices are closed, bond desks are dark, and the mail does not run.
segments.tr: Bundesbehörden sind geschlossen, Anleihenschalter bleiben dunkel und die Post wird nicht zugestellt.

segments.src: Here is a plain look at what closes, what stays open, and how the holiday's meaning has changed.
segments.tr: Hier ist eine einfache Übersicht darüber, was schließt, was geöffnet bleibt und wie sich die Bedeutung des Feiertags verändert hat.

segments.src: ## What closes
segments.tr: ## Was schließt

segments.src: Because the day is a federal holiday, the following generally observe it:
segments.tr: Da es sich bei dem Tag um einen Bundesfeiertag handelt, gilt im Allgemeinen folgendes:

segments.src: - **Federal government offices.** Most non-essential federal agencies are closed, and federal employees get a paid day off.
segments.tr: - **Bundesbehörden.** Die meisten nicht-essenziellen Bundesbehörden sind geschlossen, und Bundesbedienstete erhalten einen bezahlten freien Tag.

segments.src: - **The Federal Reserve.** Federal Reserve Banks are closed, and the Fedwire funds-transfer service and the Federal Reserve's ACH operations do not run for the day.
segments.tr: - **Die US-Notenbank (Federal Reserve).** Die Federal Reserve Banks sind geschlossen, und der Fedwire-Geldtransferdienst sowie die ACH-Operationen der Federal Reserve laufen an diesem Tag nicht.

segments.src: - **The U.S. Postal Service.** Regular mail delivery is suspended, and post offices are closed.
segments.tr: - **Der US-Postdienst (U.S. Postal Service).** Die reguläre Postzustellung ist ausgesetzt und Postämter sind geschlossen.

segments.src: - **Federal courts.** Courthouses are closed, apart from emergency matters.
segments.tr: - **Bundesgerichte.** Gerichtsgebäude sind, abgesehen von Notfällen, geschlossen.

segments.src: - **The bond market.** The Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) recommends a full close for U.S. fixed-income trading, so Treasury and most corporate bond desks stay shut.
segments.tr: - **Der Anleihenmarkt.** Die Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (SIFMA) empfiehlt eine vollständige Schließung für den US-Festverzinslichen-Handel, sodass die Schalter für Staatsanleihen und die meisten Unternehmensanleihen geschlossen bleiben.

segments.src: Many banks close their branches as well, since they follow the Federal Reserve calendar.
segments.tr: Viele Banken schließen ebenfalls ihre Filialen, da sie sich nach dem Kalender der Federal Reserve richten.

segments.src: This is a custom rather than a legal requirement for private institutions, so some banks, credit unions and online lenders keep limited hours.
segments.tr: Dies ist für private Institutionen eher eine Gewohnheit als eine rechtliche Verpflichtung, sodass einige Banken, Kreditgenossenschaften und Online-Kreditgeber eingeschränkte Öffnungszeiten haben.

segments.src: Transactions started on the holiday, such as deposits and transfers, are usually processed the next business day.
segments.tr: Transaktionen, die an dem Feiertag getätigt werden, wie Einzahlungen und Überweisungen, werden in der Regel am nächsten Werktag bearbeitet.

segments.tr: ## Was geöffnet bleibt

segments.tr: Aktienbörsen, einschließlich der NYSE und der Nasdaq, behalten an diesem Feiertag ihren regulären Zeitplan bei.

segments.src: Options markets generally trade as well.
segments.tr: Optionsmärkte handeln im Allgemeinen ebenfalls.

segments.src: Their holiday calendars are set by the exchanges themselves and include only a few closures, such as New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr.

segments.src: Day, Presidents' Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas.

segments.src: The result is a lopsided trading day.
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis ist ein unausgewogener Handelstag.

segments.src: Stocks trade, but the settlement system that moves cash and securities depends on the banking infrastructure that is closed.
segments.tr: Aktien werden gehandelt, aber das Abwicklungssystem, das Bargeld und Wertpapiere bewegt, hängt von der Bankeninfrastruktur ab, die geschlossen ist.

segments.src: As a result, stock trades made on the holiday settle on a slightly delayed schedule.
segments.tr: Infolgedessen werden an dem Feiertag getätigte Aktiengeschäfte nach einem leicht verzögerten Zeitplan abgewickelt.

segments.src: Volume is often lighter than usual, because bond-market participants and many institutional traders are away.
segments.tr: Das Handelsvolumen ist oft geringer als üblich, da Teilnehmer des Anleihenmarkts und viele institutionelle Händler abwesend sind.

segments.src: Some large firms also operate with reduced staff.
segments.tr: Einige große Unternehmen arbeiten zudem mit reduzierter Belegschaft.

segments.src: With Treasury markets closed, there is no regular benchmark for yields during the day.
segments.tr: Da die Anleihenmärkte geschlossen sind, gibt es tagsüber keinen regulären Benchmark für Renditen.

segments.src: Investors who watch interest rates often wait until Tuesday for a fresh reading, and any news released over the holiday may only be reflected in bond prices when trading resumes.
segments.tr: Investoren, die Zinssätze beobachten, warten oft bis Dienstag auf einen frischen Wert, und Nachrichten, die während des Feiertags veröffentlicht werden, spiegeln sich möglicherweise erst dann in den Anleihenkursen wider, wenn der Handel wieder aufgenommen wird.

segments.src: stock exchanges, including the NYSE and Nasdaq, keep their regular schedule on this holiday.
segments.tr: sở giao dịch chứng khoán Hoa Kỳ, bao gồm NYSE và Nasdaq, vẫn giữ nguyên lịch trình bình thường vào ngày lễ này.

segments.src: Options markets generally trade as well.
segments.tr: Thị trường quyền chọn nhìn chung cũng giao dịch.

segments.src: Their holiday calendars are set by the exchanges themselves and include only a few closures, such as New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr.
segments.tr: Lịch nghỉ lễ của họ được thiết lập bởi chính các sàn giao dịch và chỉ bao gồm một vài ngày đóng cửa, chẳng hạn như Ngày năm mới, Ngày Martin Luther King Jr.

segments.src: Day, Presidents' Day, Good Friday, Memorial Day, Juneteenth, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas.
segments.tr: Ngày, Ngày Tổng thống, Thứ Sáu Tuần Thánh, Ngày tưởng niệm, Juneteenth, Ngày độc lập, Ngày lao động, Lễ Tạ ơn và Giáng sinh.

segments.src: Columbus Day and Veterans Day are not on that list.
segments.tr: Ngày Columbus và Ngày cựu chiến binh không có trong danh sách đó.

segments.src: The result is a lopsided trading day.
segments.tr: Kết quả là một ngày giao dịch mất cân đối.

segments.src: Stocks trade, but the settlement system that moves cash and securities depends on the banking infrastructure that is closed.
segments.tr: Cổ phiếu giao dịch, nhưng hệ thống thanh toán di chuyển tiền mặt và chứng khoán phụ thuộc vào cơ sở hạ tầng ngân hàng đang đóng cửa.

segments.src: As a result, stock trades made on the holiday settle on a slightly delayed schedule.
segments.tr: Do đó, các giao dịch chứng khoán thực hiện vào ngày lễ sẽ được thanh toán theo lịch trình chậm hơn một chút.

segments.src: Volume is often lighter than usual, because bond-market participants and many institutional traders are away.
segments.tr: Khối lượng giao dịch thường thấp hơn bình thường vì những người tham gia thị trường trái phiếu và nhiều nhà giao dịch tổ chức đang nghỉ.

segments.src: Some large firms also operate with reduced staff.
segments.tr: Một số công ty lớn cũng hoạt động với số lượng nhân viên giảm bớt.

segments.src: With Treasury markets closed, there is no regular benchmark for yields during the day.
segments.tr: Khi thị trường Kho bạc đóng cửa, không có chuẩn mực thường xuyên nào cho lợi suất trong ngày.

segments.src: Investors who watch interest rates often wait until Tuesday for a fresh reading, and any news released over the holiday may only be reflected in bond prices when trading resumes.
segments.tr: Các nhà đầu tư theo dõi lãi suất thường đợi đến thứ Ba để có con số mới, và bất kỳ tin tức nào được công bố trong kỳ nghỉ lễ có thể chỉ được phản ánh vào giá trái phiếu khi giao dịch tiếp tục.

segments.src: ## Why the calendars differ
segments.tr: ## Tại sao lịch lại khác nhau

segments.src: The split comes from history and custom, not from any single rule.
segments.tr: Sự chia rẽ này xuất phát từ lịch sử và tập quán chứ không phải từ một quy tắc duy nhất.

segments.src: The federal calendar is set by law and by the Federal Reserve's observance of it.
segments.tr: Lịch liên bang được quy định bởi luật pháp và sự tuân thủ của Cục Dự trữ Liên bang đối với lịch đó.

segments.src: Exchange calendars are set by private operators and approved by regulators, and they have never tracked the federal list exactly.
segments.tr: Lịch giao dịch do các nhà điều hành tư nhân thiết lập và được cơ quan quản lý phê duyệt, và chúng chưa bao giờ theo sát danh sách liên bang một cách chính xác.

segments.src: Other days, such as Good Friday, run the other way: it is not a federal holiday, but stock exchanges close for it.
segments.tr: Những ngày khác, chẳng hạn như Thứ Sáu Tuần Thánh, lại diễn ra theo chiều ngược lại: đó không phải là ngày lễ liên bang, nhưng các sàn giao dịch chứng khoán lại đóng cửa.

segments.src: ## A holiday with a changing meaning
segments.tr: ## Một ngày lễ với ý nghĩa thay đổi

segments.src: Columbus Day was first marked in the United States in the 18th and 19th centuries, with early celebrations in cities such as New York.
segments.tr: Ngày Columbus lần đầu tiên được đánh dấu ở Hoa Kỳ vào thế kỷ 18 và 19, với các lễ kỷ niệm sớm ở các thành phố như New York.

segments.src: The day gained national momentum in the late 19th century, particularly among Italian American communities that saw it as a celebration of heritage and belonging at a time of widespread discrimination.
segments.tr: Ngày này đã có đà phát triển toàn quốc vào cuối thế kỷ 19, đặc biệt là trong các cộng đồng người Mỹ gốc Ý, những người coi đó là lễ kỷ niệm di sản và sự thuộc về vào thời điểm phân biệt đối xử lan rộng.

segments.src: President Franklin D.
segments.tr: Tổng thống Franklin D.

segments.src: Roosevelt proclaimed it a national observance in 1937, and it became a federal holiday observed on the second Monday of October through the Uniform Monday Holiday Act, which took effect in 1971.
segments.tr: Roosevelt đã tuyên bố đây là ngày lễ quốc gia vào năm 1937, và nó trở a ngày lễ liên bang được kỷ niệm vào thứ Hai thứ hai của tháng Mười thông qua Đạo luật nghỉ lễ thứ Hai đồng nhất, có hiệu lực vào năm 1971.

segments.src: In recent decades, many communities have questioned whether the day should honor Christopher Columbus, citing the harm that European colonization caused Indigenous peoples.
segments.tr: Trong những thập kỷ gần đây, nhiều cộng đồng đã đặt câu hỏi liệu ngày này có nên tôn vinh Christopher Columbus hay không, viện dẫn những tổn hại mà sự thực thi thuộc địa của châu Âu gây ra cho các dân tộc bản địa.

segments.src: South Dakota began observing Native American Day in place of Columbus Day in 1990.
segments.tr: Nam Dakota bắt đầu kỷ niệm Ngày người Mỹ bản địa thay cho Ngày Columbus vào năm 1990.

segments.src: Berkeley, California, adopted Indigenous Peoples' Day in 1992, and a growing number of states, cities, school districts and universities have since followed with Indigenous Peoples' Day or similar names.
segments.tr: Berkeley, California, đã thông qua Ngày các dân tộc bản địa vào năm 1992, và ngày càng có nhiều tiểu bang, thành phố, học khu và trường đại học tiếp tục áp dụng Ngày các dân tộc bản địa hoặc tên tương tự.

segments.src: In 2021, President Biden issued the first presidential proclamation recognizing Indigenous Peoples' Day, and he issued a Columbus Day proclamation at the same time.
segments.tr: Năm 2021, Tổng thống Biden đã đưa ra tuyên bố tổng thống đầu tiên công nhận Ngày các dân tộc bản địa, và ông đồng thời đưa ra tuyên bố về Ngày Columbus.

segments.src: The federal statute still calls the holiday Columbus Day.
segments.tr: Đạo luật liên bang vẫn gọi ngày lễ này là Ngày Columbus.

segments.src: That is why federal calendars, the Federal Reserve schedule and bond-market calendars still use the name, even while local governments and institutions use another.
segments.tr: Đó là lý do tại sao lịch liên bang, lịch của Cục Dự trữ Liên bang và lịch thị trường trái phiếu vẫn sử dụng tên này, ngay cả khi chính quyền địa phương và các tổ chức sử dụng tên khác.

segments.src: Some places mark both.
segments.tr: Một số nơi đánh dấu cả hai.

segments.src: Italian American organizations continue to hold parades and cultural events, and many Native American communities hold their own gatherings, educational programs and commemorations on the same day.
segments.tr: Các tổ chức người Mỹ gốc Ý tiếp tục tổ chức diễu hành và các sự kiện văn hóa, và nhiều cộng đồng người Mỹ bản địa tổ chức các buổi họp mặt, chương trình giáo dục và lễ tưởng niệm của riêng họ vào cùng một ngày.

segments.src: ## What to expect
segments.tr: ## Những gì mong đợi

segments.src: - **Plan around the Fed calendar.** If you need to move money, expect transfers to post on Tuesday.
segments.tr: - **Lập kế hoạch xung quanh lịch của Fed.** Nếu bạn cần chuyển tiền, hãy mong đợi các giao dịch chuyển khoản được đăng vào thứ Ba.

segments.src: - **Check local hours.** State and city offices, libraries, schools and public transit vary widely, depending on whether a jurisdiction observes the day and under what name.
segments.tr: - **Kiểm tra giờ làm việc tại địa phương.** Các văn phòng tiểu bang và thành phố, thư viện, trường học và phương tiện giao thông công cộng rất khác nhau, tùy thuộc vào việc khu vực tài phán đó có tuân thủ ngày lễ hay không và theo tên gì.

segments.src: - **Check before you go.** Banks, credit unions and businesses may set their own holiday hours, so confirm before making a trip.
segments.tr: - **Kiểm tra trước khi đi.** Các ngân hàng, liên hiệp tín dụng và doanh nghiệp có thể thiết lập giờ nghỉ lễ của riêng họ, vì vậy hãy xác nhận trước khi thực hiện chuyến đi.

segments.src: One date on the calendar, then, carries several meanings at once: a pause in the financial plumbing, a day when equities keep moving, and an occasion that communities across the country continue to define in different ways.
segments.tr: Do đó, một ngày trên lịch mang nhiều ý nghĩa cùng một lúc: sự tạm dừng trong hệ thống tài chính, một ngày mà cổ phiếu tiếp tục chuyển động và một dịp mà các cộng đồng trên khắp đất nước tiếp tục định nghĩa theo những cách khác nhau.
